31762-the-record-of-currupira.title: The Record Of Currupira
31762-the-record-of-currupira.creator: Unknown
31762-the-record-of-currupira.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. On the label someone had painstakingly copied the Martian glyphs found on the mummy's original case. Dalton's eyes traced the looping ornamental script--he was one of the very few men who had put in the years of work necessary to read inscriptional Martian--and he smiled appreciation of a jest that had taken fifty thousand years to ripen--the writing said simply, _Man From Earth_.

37574-great-inventions-and-discoveries.title: Great Inventions And Discoveries
37574-great-inventions-and-discoveries.creator: Willis Duff Piercy
37574-great-inventions-and-discoveries.description: A book by Willis Duff Piercy. om human souls whom we never saw, who lived perhaps thousands of miles away; and yet these, on those little sheets of paper, speak to us, amuse us, vivify us, teach us, comfort us, open their hearts to us as brothers.

arxiv-2101-07563.title: Using StyleGAN for Visual Interpretability of Deep Learning Models on Medical Images
arxiv-2101-07563.creator: Kathryn Schutte, Olivier Moindrot, Paul Hérent, Jean-Baptiste Schiratti, Simon Jégou
arxiv-2101-07563.description: Abstract As AI-based medical devices are becoming more common in imaging fields like radiology and histology, interpretability of the underlying predictive models is crucial to expand their use in clinical practice. Existing heatmap-based interpretability methods such as GradCAM only highlight the location of predictive features but do not explain how they contribute to the prediction.

arxiv-2105-04773.title: An Innovative Security Strategy using Reactive Web Application Honeypot
arxiv-2105-04773.creator: 1 st Rajat Gupta, 2 nd Madhu Viswanatham V, 3 rd Manikandan K
arxiv-2105-04773.description: Abstract Nowadays, web applications have become most prevalent in the industry, and the critical data of most organizations stored using web apps. Hence, web applications a much bigger target for diverse cyber-attacks, which varies from database injections-SQL injection, PHP object injection, template injection, XML external entity injection, unsanitized input attacks- Cross-Site Scripting(XSS) and many more.

arxiv-2105-12356.title: The Graph Cut Kernel for Ranked Data
arxiv-2105-12356.creator: Michelangelo Conserva m.conserva@qmul.ac.uk, Marc Peter Deisenroth m.deisenroth@ucl.ac.uk, K S Sesh Kumar s.karri@imperial.ac.uk
arxiv-2105-12356.description: Abstract Many algorithms for ranked data become computationally intractable as the number of objects grows due to the complex geometric structure induced by rankings. An additional challenge is posed by partial rankings, i.e. rankings in which the preference is only known for a subset of all objects.

arxiv-2109-14699.title: A geometric recipe for twisted superpotentials Based on lectures given by the first author at the Pre-StringMath Summer School , 17–21 July 2017, and at StringMath 2017 , 24–28 July 2017, Hamburg University.
arxiv-2109-14699.creator: Lotte Hollands, Philipp Rüter, Richard J. Szabo
arxiv-2109-14699.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Lotte Hollands, Philipp Rüter, Richard J. Szabo. We give a pedagogical introduction to spectral networks and abelianization, as well as their relevance to 𝒩 = 2 {\mathcal{N}}=2 supersymmetric field theories in four dimensions. Motivated by a conjecture of Nekrasov-Rosly-Shatashvili, we detail a geometric recipe for computing the effective twisted superpotential for 𝒩 = 2 {\mathcal{N}}=2 field theories of class 𝒮 \mathcal{S} as a generating function of the brane of opers, with respect to the spectral coordinates found from abelianization.

arxiv-2205-13631.title: Size-Dependent Nucleation in Crystal Phase Transition from Machine Learning Metadynamics
arxiv-2205-13631.creator: Pedro A. Santos-Florez, Howard Yanxon, Byungkyun Kang, Yansun Yao, Qiang Zhu
arxiv-2205-13631.description: Abstract In this work, we present an efficient framework that combines machine learning potential (MLP) and metadynamics to explore multi-dimensional free energy surfaces for investigating solid-solid phase transition. Based on the spectral descriptors and neural networks regression, we have developed a computationally scalable MLP model to warrant an accurate interpolation of the energy surface where two phases coexist.

arxiv-2209-13882.title: Bounds for moments of symmetric square L L -functions
arxiv-2209-13882.creator: Peng Gao
arxiv-2209-13882.description: Abstract . We study the 2 ​ k 2k -th moment at the central point of the family of symmetric square L L -functions attached to holomorphic Hecke cusp forms of level one, weight κ \kappa . We establish sharp lower bounds for all real k ≥ 1 / 2 k\geq 1/2 unconditionally.

arxiv-2312-13627.title: CTPU-PTC-23-55 Limits on heavy neutral leptons, Z ′ Z^{\prime} bosons and majorons from high-energy supernova neutrinos
arxiv-2312-13627.creator: Kensuke Akita, Sang Hui Im, Mehedi Masud, Seokhoon Yun, *[20pt] Particle Theory and Cosmology Group, Center for Theoretical Physics of the Universe,Institute for Basic Science (IBS), Daejeon, 34126, Korea, *[5pt] High Energy Physics Center, Chung-Ang University,Dongjak-gu, Seoul 06974, Korea *[50pt]
arxiv-2312-13627.description: Abstract 1 Introduction The hot (T\sim 30\ {\rm MeV}) and dense (\rho\sim 3\times 10^{14}\ {\rm g/cm^{3}}) cores in supernovae (SNe) provide an environment to test feebly interacting particles (FIPs) [ 1 ] . In the core, particles with masses up to m\sim 100\ {\rm MeV} can be produced.

arxiv-2401-13439.title: Model Predictive Wave Disturbance Rejection for Underwater Soft Robotic Manipulators
arxiv-2401-13439.creator: Kyle L. Walker, Cosimo Della Santina, Francesco Giorgio-Serchi
arxiv-2401-13439.description: Abstract Inspired by the octopus and other animals living in water, soft robots should naturally lend themselves to underwater operations, as supported by encouraging validations in deep water scenarios. This work deals with equipping soft arms with the intelligence necessary to move precisely in wave-dominated environments, such as shallow waters where marine renewable devices are located.

arxiv-2403-10627.title: A Size-Consistent Multi-State Mapping Approach to Surface Hopping
arxiv-2403-10627.creator: Joseph E. Lawrence, Jonathan R. Mannouch, Jeremy O. Richardson
arxiv-2403-10627.description: Abstract We develop a multi-state generalisation of the recently proposed mapping approach to surface hopping (MASH) for the simulation of electronically nonadiabatic dynamics. This new approach extends the original MASH method to be able to treat systems with more than two electronic states.

arxiv-2406-09758.title: Defect Induced Heavy Meson Dynamics
arxiv-2406-09758.creator: in
arxiv-2406-09758.description: Abstract 1 Introduction The conformal window is the region in the number of flavours versus colours of asymptotically free gauge theories where the theory achieves conformality in the infrared. The phase diagram for QCD and QCD-like theories appeared in [ 1 , 2 ] .

arxiv-2409-10496.title: MusicLIME: Explainable Multimodal Music Understanding
arxiv-2409-10496.creator: Theodoros Sotirou ⋆ , Vassilis Lyberatos ⋆ , Orfeas Menis Mastromichalakis ⋆ , Giorgos Stamou ⋆
arxiv-2409-10496.description: Abstract Multimodal models are critical for music understanding tasks, as they capture the complex interplay between audio and lyrics. However, as these models become more prevalent, the need for explainability grows—understanding how these systems make decisions is vital for ensuring fairness, reducing bias, and fostering trust.

arxiv-2506-04653.title: The Oversmoothing Fallacy: A Misguided Narrative in GNN Research
arxiv-2506-04653.creator: MoonJeong Park, Sunghyun Choi, Jaeseung Heo, Eunhyeok Park, Dongwoo Kim
arxiv-2506-04653.description: Abstract Oversmoothing has been recognized as a main obstacle to building deep Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), limiting the performance. This position paper argues that the influence of oversmoothing has been overstated and advocates for a further exploration of deep GNN architectures.

arxiv-2603-05308.title: Med-V1: Small Language Models for Zero-shot and Scalable Biomedical Evidence Attribution
arxiv-2603-05308.creator: Qiao Jin, Yin Fang, Lauren He, Yifan Yang, Guangzhi Xiong, Zhizheng Wang, Nicholas Wan, Joey Chan, Donald C. Comeau, Robert Leaman, Charalampos S. Floudas, Aidong Zhang, Michael F. Chiang, Yifan Peng, Zhiyong Lu

pmc-10558421.title: Porphyrin-derived carbon dots for an enhanced antiviral activity targeting the CTD of SARS-CoV-2 nucleocapsid
pmc-10558421.creator: Azzania Fibriani, Audrey Angelina Putri Taharuddin, Nicholas Yamahoki, Rebecca Stephanie, Jessica Laurelia, Dian Fitria Agustiyanti, Popi Hadi Wisnuwardhani, Marissa Angelina, Yana Rubiyana, Ratih Asmana Ningrum, Andri Wardiana, Desriani Desriani, Ferry Iskandar, Fitri Aulia Permatasari, Ernawati Ar
pmc-10558421.description: BackgroundSince effective antiviral drugs for COVID-19 are still limited in number, the exploration of compounds that have antiviral activity against SARS-CoV-2 is in high demand. Porphyrin is potentially developed as a COVID-19 antiviral drug. However, its low solubility in water restricts its clinical application.

pmc-11607533.title: It Takes Guts: Interactions of Intestinal Stearoyl CoA Desaturase 1 and Bile Acids
pmc-11607533.creator: Jessica M Ferrell
pmc-11607533.description: , 4 The mechanism of action may involve altered bile acid physiology; in addition to their roles as physiological detergents, bile acids bind metabolic receptors to promote lipid and energy metabolism. Bile acids also shape the gut microbiota composition, and the microbiota reciprocally alters bile acid composition.

pmc-11728726.title: Oral Vaccine Formulation for Immunocastration Using a Live-Attenuated Salmonella ΔSPI2 Strain as an Antigenic Vector
pmc-11728726.creator: Sergio A Bucarey, Lucy D Maldonado, Francisco Duarte, Alejandro A Hidalgo, Leonardo Sáenz, Hosni Hassan
pmc-11728726.description: Immunization against Gonadotropin-Releasing Hormone (GnRH) has been successfully explored and developed for the parenteral inoculation of animals, aimed at controlling fertility, reducing male aggressiveness, and preventing boar taint. Although effective, these vaccines may cause adverse reactions at the injection site, including immunosuppression and inflammation, as well as the involvement of laborious and time-consuming procedures.

pmc-11805032.title: Assessment of Nasal Morphology within various Sagittal Skeletal Growth Patterns—A Cross-sectional Cephalometric Study
pmc-11805032.creator: Romilkumar Shah, Aakash Shah
pmc-11805032.description: Aim:The present research aims to assess the nasal morphology within various Sagittal skeletal growth patterns like Classes I, II and III.Material and Method:The present research assesses various nasal parameters within equally distributed 150 lateral cephalograms having Skeletal Classes I, II, and III by manual tracing. The study identified differences in nasal morphology across different skeletal classes.

pmc-12515055.title: Un‐Matched 1:1 Retrospective Case–Control Study of the Transmission of Typhoid Fever in Neno District, Malawi
pmc-12515055.creator: Priscilla Talabuku, Atusaye Mwalwanda, Elton Chavura, Tawonga Mwase‐Vuma, Balwani Chingatichifwe Mbakaya
pmc-12515055.description: Despite multidisciplinary efforts to control typhoid fever, outbreaks continue to recur in Neno District. This study aimed to identify factors contributing to typhoid transmission and explore community knowledge and empowerment strategies. The study comprised of 200 cases and 200 controls. Mixed‐method approach was used. Quantitative data were analyzed with Statistics Training Analysis Translation Assistance (STATA) version 17 to determine associations.

pmc-12534591.title: Solar-assisted tri-generation system with LCPV‑CPC and small-scale gas turbine for year-round clean energy in hot-dry climates
pmc-12534591.creator: Mohamed Bechir Ben Hamida, Rassol Hamed Rasheed, Narinderjit Singh Sawaran Singh, Mohammad Taghavi
pmc-12534591.description: This study develops, dynamically simulates, and optimizes an integrated tri‑generation system for year-round electricity, heating, and cooling supply under the hot-dry climatic conditions of Baghdad, Iraq. The proposed configuration couples a low‑concentration hybrid PV–compound parabolic concentrator (LCPV-CPC) with dual small‑scale gas turbines, high- and low-grade water-source heat pumps, and an ammonia-water absorption chiller, coordinated through a following-electric-load (FEL) strategy.

pmc-12984053.title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of an Integrated PBL–CBL–TBL Teaching Model in Postgraduate Clinical Training
pmc-12984053.creator: Chang Liu, Mo Zhang, Ying Xiao, Hua Tong, Ru Ji, Wei Wang, Qianfei Liang, Shuwen Zu, Caiyan Zhao, Yadong Wang
pmc-12984053.description: AimTo evaluate the effectiveness of a combined Problem-Based, Case-Based, and Team-Based Learning (P-C-T) teaching mode in improving academic performance and self-reported learning outcomes among postgraduates specializing in infectious diseases.MethodsThis study enrolled 100 postgraduates (Master of Medicine (MM) and Doctor of Medicine (MD)) specializing in infectious diseases from five medical colleges in Hebei Province between Jan 2020 and Dec 2024.

pmc-13122409.title: The Bit Scale: A Metric Score Scale for Unidimensional Item Response Theory Models
pmc-13122409.creator: Joakim Wallmark, Marie Wiberg
pmc-13122409.description: In item response theory (IRT), the conventional latent trait scale ( ) is inherently arbitrary, lacking a fixed unit or origin and often tied to specific population distributional assumptions (e.g., standard normal). This limits the direct comparability and interpretability of scores across different tests, populations, or model estimation methods.

pmc-13141055.title: Reflections on dental disease prevention in sub-elite competitive endurance sports: a mixed-methods analysis
pmc-13141055.creator: Annabel Simpson, Rebecca O’Hanlon, Chris Easton, Fiona Henriquez, Mia C Burleigh
pmc-13141055.description: Competitive athletes consistently demonstrate high rates of oral disease. This mixed-methods study investigated and compared the knowledge, beliefs and attitudes of athletes, coaches and dental healthcare professionals (DHPs) regarding oral disease prevention in a cohort of predominantly endurance athletes to inform future targeted health promotion.

pmc-13218179.title: Community awareness of climate change and its public health impacts in the North Bank Region, The Gambia: a community-based cross-sectional study
pmc-13218179.creator: Bakary Kinteh, Lamin Darboe, Mansour Badjie, Modou S Gaye, Sheriff Ceesay, Amadou Kongira, Sheikh Omar Sillah, Amadou Barrow
pmc-13218179.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectivesClimate change poses significant public health challenges globally, particularly in vulnerable regions such as The Gambia. Despite growing recognition of environmental impacts, limited research has examined community-level awareness of climate change health effects in West African settings. This study aimed to assess household awareness and perceptions of climate change impacts on public health among vulnerable communities in the North Bank Region, The Gambia and identify socio-demographic determinants of climate change awareness.Design and settingIn this study, we conducted a community-based cross-sectional study.

pmc-13284062.title: Stimuli-Responsive Nanocarriers for Transdermal siRNA Delivery: Mechanisms, Challenges, and Therapeutic Strategies
pmc-13284062.creator: Yanmin Jian, Minghui Ban, Zhenyang Yan, Yansui Wang, Ziyan Che, Wenwen Ren, Yuan Cao, Zao Wang, Yue Yuan

pmc-13327181.title: Machine learning for risk stratification of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy: Enhancing clinical efficiency in low-resource antenatal care in Tanzania
pmc-13327181.creator: Isaac Lyatuu, Emmanuel P. Mwanga, Yusuph Kulindwa, Raymond Bandio, Alen Kinyina, Ntuli Kapologwe, Phineas Sospeter, Ahmad Makuwani, James Tumaini, Omari Sukari, Augustino Hellar, Dhiya Al-Jumeily OBE, Anna Khalemsky, Dhiya Al-Jumeily OBE, Anna Khalemsky, Dhiya Al-Jumeily OBE, Anna Khalemsky
pmc-13327181.description: Maternal mortality in Tanzania remains a public health crisis, with Hypertensive Disorders of Pregnancy (HDP) causing 34% of direct obstetric deaths. In overburdened government clinics, high patient volumes and limited resources often restrict assessments to single-point blood pressure checks, leading to missed diagnoses.

pmc-13364438.title: Toward Predictive Design of Lignocellulosic Mycelium-Bound Composites: A Process–Structure–Property Framework, Quantitative Synthesis, and Standardization Roadmap
pmc-13364438.creator: Musiliu A. Liadi, Tawakalt O. Ayodele, Ibrahim A. Bello, C. Igathinathane, Hammed M. Ademola
pmc-13364438.description: Mycelium-bound composites (MBCs) have emerged as a promising class of biofabricated materials that integrate fungal hyphal networks with lignocellulosic substrates to form lightweight, biodegradable structures without synthetic adhesives. Despite rapid growth in the field, the current literature remains fragmented, with inconsistent methodologies and widely varying reported material properties.

pmc-13408590.title: Chitosan Mitigates Functional Deterioration of Myofibrillar Protein After Chlorogenic Acid-Induced Oxidation: Structure Restoration and Interfacial Regulation
pmc-13408590.creator: Junren Zhao, Yugang Ji, Wenjing Tao, Chun Wang, Zhimei Tang, Yujia Shi, Huiyun Zhang
pmc-13408590.description: Chlorogenic acid (CA) exhibits robust lipid antioxidant activity within meat matrices. However, excess CA generates quinones that alter and damage porcine myofibrillar protein (MP). This study investigated the restorative effects of chitosan (CS) on MPs suffering from CA-induced oxidative damage. Three CA concentrations (0, 50, 100 μmol/g protein) and five CS dosages (0.125–1.

pmc-13426240.title: Induction-phase infliximab monitoring accelerates time to remission in pediatric IBD: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-13426240.creator: Nicholas Iovino, Samantha R Paglinco, Mahmoud Abdel-Rasoul, Megan McNicol, Brendan Boyle, Hilary K Michel, Ross M Maltz
pmc-13426240.description: BackgroundIn pediatric inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), the optimal timing to begin therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM) of infliximab (IFX) is unclear. We hypothesized that TDM during induction of IFX improves clinical outcomes in children with IBD.MethodsThis retrospective cohort study utilized data from an internal database at Nationwide Children’s Hospital between January 1, 2020, and December 31, 2023.

pmc-13469300.title: RNF26 bridges ER stress and autophagy in the clearance of MERS envelope protein
pmc-13469300.creator: Ziyue Li, Yang Wang, Jingbo Qie, Shuangqu Li, Zhaobing Gao, Hin Chu, Bingqing Xia
pmc-13469300.description: Coronavirus envelope (E) proteins are small, highly conserved viroporins essential for virion assembly and pathogenicity. Despite extensive characterization of their ion channel activity, how host cells sense and dispose of excessive viral membrane proteins remains poorly understood. Here we show that expression of the MERS-CoV E protein triggers pronounced ER stress and autophagy activation in human cells.

uslaw-usc-t15-s6406.title: 15 U.S.C. § 6406 — Compliance
uslaw-usc-t15-s6406.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s6406.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 90 (Propane Education And Research). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Council may bring suit in Federal court to compel compliance with an assessment levied by the Council under this chapter. A successful action for compliance under this section may also require payment by the defendant of the costs incurred by the Council.

uslaw-usc-t2-s192.title: 2 U.S.C. § 192 — Refusal of witness to testify or produce papers
uslaw-usc-t2-s192.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t2-s192.description: United States Code, Title 2 (The Congress); Chapter 6 (Congressional And Committee Procedure; Investigations). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Every person who having been summoned as a witness by the authority of either House of Congress to give testimony or to produce papers upon any matter under inquiry before either House, or any joint committee established by a joint or concurrent resolution.
